comment: RECORD-M3-11's freeze vectors over stored bytes: one entry of every kind M3 writes, sealed in order as one writer's chain in one log, each drawing its entry_id, key, salt and nonce from random, in that order, and pushed in one slot at key_index 0 up; each entry's slot row is key || salt; deposit_batch is the first two entries as a depositor sends them; decision is the approval_decision entry's body, a Signed by the approver's key; actions are one of each kind the builder makes. Ed25519 signs deterministically, so the bytes follow from the inputs, and every leg must compute them. go test -run TestRecordFreezeVectorsSealAgainToTheFile -update-record-freeze-vectors rewrites this file.
